subject: Urgent: sustained tail-latency, throughput cliff, and commercial remediation
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@bluewave.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@bluewave.ai
Date: 2027-09-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: High sustained tail-latency + 5xx spike affecting production — need remediation and credit discussion

Rishi —

We started seeing a sustained degradation in our production latency and throughput starting ~08:30 PDT this morning. Over the last 2 hours:
- 99th percentile latency for text-generation requests has increased from ~450ms to ~2.4s.
- Request throughput on our primary route dropped by ~38%.
- Error rate (5xx) spiked to ~4.2% (baseline ~0.1%).

This is impacting our user-facing recommendation flow. We have temporarily throttled traffic, but this is causing significant feature degradation and customer churn risk. Attached is a screenshot of the anomaly and a short SLO export.

We need a remediation timeline and a commercial proposal for make-whole/credits — our procurement needs numbers and an internal exec briefing later today. Can you escalate immediately?

Please include engineering and the account team.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Mehta
VP Product, BlueWave AI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High sustained tail-latency + 5xx spike affecting production — need remediation and credit discussion

Sanjay — thank you for the heads up and the attachments. I’m really sorry you hit this. We’ve opened an incident and I’ve looped in Soojin (engineering) and Vanessa (your account lead).

Immediate steps I’m taking now:
1) Soojin: full stack triage and mitigation; we need a mitigation ETA (10–30 min) and a root-cause ETA (2–6 hours).
2) Ops: collect request traces, kernel logs, autoscale events — please send over the range you pulled (timestamps attached look right).
3) Commercial: Vanessa, I’ll let you lead on an interim credit framework we can present to BlueWave while engineering closes the loop.

Sanjay — I’ll set up an executive sync at 13:00 PDT if that works for you. I’ll also prepare a provisional commercial remediation figure we can refine once Soojin confirms blast radius.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High sustained tail-latency + 5xx spike affecting production — need remediation and credit discussion

On Wed, Sep 22, 2027 at 09:27, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sanjay — thank you for the heads up and the attachments. I’m really sorry you hit this. We’ve opened an incident and I’ve looped in Soojin (engineering) and Vanessa (your account lead).

Quick update from the triage: we identified a rollout yesterday that changed an autoscaling threshold for the serving pools backing your region. The change exposed a kernel path that substantially increases per-token compute for sequences >2048 tokens in the current quantized path. Under combined load patterns from BlueWave’s recommendation batch and streaming inference, the autoscaler undershot available workers which increased queueing and tail latency; some requests timed out and generated 5xxs.

What we’ve done so far:
- Reverted the autoscale threshold change (09:35 PDT).
- Forced a hotfix to bypass the degraded kernel path for requests >2k tokens (09:42 PDT).
- Rolling capacity bump to catch up backfill (started 09:50 PDT).

Current status: latency improving but still elevated for a subset of long-sequence requests. We expect 80% reduction of the elevated 99p within 60 minutes and return to baseline within 3 hours. Root-cause RCA and full performance regression test will be done within 6 hours.

Immediate asks from BlueWave ops: logs for affected request IDs, and confirmation of your traffic slices when this occurred. We have collected the following artifacts and attached a short SLO export and a screenshot.

Apologies for the impact — we’ll follow up with a write-up and a proposed remediation credit after we quantify the outage window and affected units.

—Soojin Lee
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@bluewave.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed interim remediation credit — BlueWave AI

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for raising this in the morning. We’re pulling formal numbers from engineering but wanted to propose an interim commercial remediation so your procurement and finance teams have something to review before our exec call. This is intentionally conservative and we can adjust based on the final SLO window.

Interim proposal (subject to final SLO quantification):
- A service credit equal to 12% of your monthly recurring invoice for the impacted billing period, OR
- If BlueWave prefers transaction-level credits, a token/throughput-based credit equivalent to 12% of the charged units for the exact outage window (we can provide a spreadsheet).

We will:
- Share a draft credit calc (attached) that maps to the BlueWave invoiced line items.
- Present a final RCA and the exact outage window within 6 hours.

Next steps:
1) Sanjay — confirm which remediation type you prefer (invoice credit vs transaction credit).
2) If you accept, we’ll push a DocuSign amendment for signature and apply the credit to the next billing cycle or issue a one-time invoice credit per your finance preference.

We’ll also prepare an exec-level one-pager for the 13:00 PDT briefing.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Account Director, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@bluewave.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@bluewave.ai
Date: 2027-09-22T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed interim remediation credit — BlueWave AI

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the quick proposal. A few clarifications from procurement side: 
1) We prefer a token/throughput-level credit tied to the outage window (clear audit trail for our auditors).
2) Need the exact start and end timestamps you’ll use to compute the window — we’ll cross-check our logs.
3) Our execs want a hard number for the credit amount before the 13:00 call. 

Please also include whether Redwood will accept a short-term SLA amendment to add an explicit uptime target for our primary generation route while we complete the postmortem (we want an operational commitment for the next 90 days).

We’ll be on the 13:00 exec call. Sanjay
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay.mehta@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-25T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Postmortem, mutual action plan, and proposed credit formula — BlueWave AI incident (Sep 22)

Sanjay — thanks again for the productive executive conversation earlier. Following up with the agreed mutual action plan and the final commercial proposal. See attached: the SLO export we used, the error snapshot, and the proposed credit calc.

Summary:
- Incident window we’ve agreed to: 2027-09-22T08:18:00-07:00 through 2027-09-22T10:05:00-07:00 (1h47m).
- Root cause: autoscale threshold regression + degraded kernel path for >2048 token sequences. Change reverted and hotfix deployed; full regression testing completed by 2027-09-22T15:00:00-07:00.
- Impact: elevated 99p latency and 5xxs concentrated on long-sequence generation requests; total affected charged units (tokens) for the window: 3,412,800 tokens (per SLO export).

Agreed commercial remediation (final):
- BlueWave selects transaction-level credit. We apply a 20% credit to the invoiced charge for the affected tokens for the outage window. Using your line-item rates, that maps to $18,720 credit.
- Execution: Redwood will apply the $18,720 as a one-time invoice credit to the next billing cycle and will issue a formal amendment via DocuSign for signature (link attached).

Operational commitments:
- We will add an explicit temporary SLA addendum for your primary generation route for 90 days (99.5% availability target for calls under 60s) and provide weekly latency reports.
- Engineering will deliver a full RCA document and a permanent mitigation plan (kernel/path fix and autoscale guardrails) by 2027-09-29.

Attachments: SLO export (slo_report_20270922-20270925.pdf), error snapshot (bluewave_error_snapshot_20270922.png), proposed credit calc (proposed_service_credit_calc.xlsx).

Action items:
- Rishi: prepare DocuSign amendment and route for signature (today).
- Vanessa: confirm billing apply date and notify finance.
- Sanjay: confirm acceptance in reply so we can move DocuSign.

We regret the impact and appreciate the partnership as we get this fully remediated.

—Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
